entry_state: Instrument reduction freezes earlier designated gains without removing purchase volume. Stopping a homogeneous purchase portion instead freezes its attached reserve, with expectation and loss findings deciding later release. Distinct perfectly matched designation origins give different canceled-purchase outcomes even with identical derivative cash. Inventory receipt then transfers the retained reserve to cost directly; terminal totals alone can conceal a wrong interim profit entry.
exit_state: Inventory sales and recoveries retain only unsold cost and allowance. A net hedge preserves gross transactions and their earnings periods, including nil-position eligibility. Award accounting then separates service and market conditions, cancellation, remeasured cash liabilities and settlement choice. Beneficial amendments preserve original cost and add their own service clock; cash-to-equity conversion removes the measured liability and recognizes the signed difference without supplying a valuation model.

findings.judgment: Partial inventory sales remove cost and allowance only for sold goods: 130 units at cost 10,800, 52 sold at cost 4,320, and 78 remaining at cost 6,480. At NRV 70 the allowance is 1,020. A later sale of 26 removes allowance 340; recovery reverses only the remaining 680, not the original 1,020. The equations motivate tracking quantity, cost and allowance before generalization. Final totals cannot establish correct interim accounting.

A net FX hedge retains gross sales and services and their reporting periods. USD 100 sales, USD 80 services and a forward of 20 produce EUR 110 revenue, EUR 88 expense and EUR 2 separate hedge expense. Different earnings dates require first-period hedge expense 10 and credit reserve 8 after derivative OCI loss 2; the later period releases 8. Nil-position designation requires all stated conditions; equal totals alone are insufficient.

IFRS 2 service and non-market vesting conditions differ from market conditions. Cumulative charges of 900, 1,600 and 2,250 follow eligible quantities and service fractions. Cancellation accelerates remaining cost and differs from forfeiture. Market/non-vesting classifications and controllability remain explicit.

Cash awards remeasure through settlement to 6,750; freezing grant-date value would omit 4,500. Employee versus entity settlement choice produces different compound/equity accounting. The statutory withholding exception is restricted and cannot be generalized to all net settlements.

A beneficial amendment preserves original cost of 300 and adds 200 incremental modification-date value. Added instruments requiring only year-two service produce charges of 100, 180 and 100. Cash-to-equity conversion recognizes service already received, removes the liability and records the signed difference; a liability of 220 would produce an expense credit of 20. Valuations and legal terms remain supplied requirements.

source_limit: Author reading of bounded, sourced accounting examples and synthetic facts. It does not establish actual-company accounting, general FX/IFRS 2 implementation, valuation models, or independent technical, domain or human acceptance.
